subject: general
question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part.

The revolt of the labourers will be considered as an __epoch__ in the world history.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"epoch"** means a particular period of time in history or a person's life, usually marked by notable events or particular characteristics. (युग)

 
 
• **Example: **The invention of the internet marked a new **epoch** in human history.
 
 
 
• **"Important period"** refers to a significant span of time that has notable impacts or events. (महत्वपूर्ण अवधि)
 
 
• **Example: **The Renaissance was an important period in European history, marked by a revival of art, culture, and learning.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "epoch" can be appropriately substituted with** "important period".**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **important period**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unpopular measure** (अलोकप्रिय उपाय): An action or decision that is not liked or supported by many people.

 
 
• **Example:** The new tax policy was an unpopular measure among the citizens.
 
 
 
• **Hostile event** (शत्रुतापूर्ण घटना): An incident that is unfriendly or antagonistic.
 
 
• **Example: **The surprise attack was a hostile event that led to the declaration of war.
 
 
 
• **Commendable act** (सराहनीय कार्य): An action that is worthy of praise or admiration.
 
 
• **Example:** Donating to charity is a commendable act that helps those in need.
